renderings.value: Emphasizes a specific item or action; 'even', 'if only', 'as long as'.

The ～さえ grammar point is used to emphasize a specific item, person, or action, implying that it alone is sufficient, remarkable, or an exception. It can be translated as 'even', 'if only', or 'as long as' in English. The formation differs slightly depending on whether it is used with a verb, い-adjective, な-adjective, or noun.
Noun + さえ, Verb-casual + さえ, い-Adjective + さえ, な-Adjective + でさえ
If only I have money, I can travel around the world.
As long as he can speak English, he can do that job.
Not only is she smart, she is also good at sports. She can even play tennis.
I like reading books in bright places. I'm fine even if I don't turn on the room light.
